name: Mishmannah
title: David's warriors from Gad
summary: Mishmannah was a warrior from the tribe of Gad who joined David while he was in the wilderness, hiding from King Saul. He is mentioned among the brave men who came to David at Ziklag and supported him before he became king over all Israel. He is counted as one of the foremost among Gad's warriors who crossed the Jordan to join David.

keyEvents.title: The Gadites Join David
keyEvents.description: Misjmanna was among the warriors from the tribe of Gad who left Saul and crossed the Jordan to join David in the strongholds of the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: Misjmanna mentioned among the commanders of Gad
keyEvents.description: Misjmanna is listed as fourth in line among the brave Gadite warriors whose faces were like lions and who were swift as gazelles on the mountains.

keyEvents.title: The Gadites' Crossing of the Jordan
keyEvents.description: The Gadites, including Misjmanna, crossed the Jordan in the first month when it overflowed all its banks, a sign of their great courage and determination.

keyEvents.title: David's Growing Army
keyEvents.description: Misjmanna was part of the growing force that came to David day after day until it became a vast army, like the army of God.
